changes: Fixed coordinate selection on scaled Windows displays by recording native physical cursor positions.
Added a Settings test for the Play button that activates VK Play and clicks the currently displayed coordinates.
Added a Current Account test that activates VK Play, reads the configured OCR area, and reports the detected account.
Added an Account Search test with an account-name prompt, real search and click verification, and current-account confirmation.
Coordinate tests now use unsaved values currently displayed in Settings, so new points and regions can be checked before saving.
Fixed the client list jumping back to the top after selecting or clearing an account.
